scope: Writer record emission, timed file playback, and reader/writer runtime teardown

applied.name: KWReplayWriter_WriteBodyRecord
applied.evidence: Writes one body record to file mode, frames network protocol message type 8 in network mode, and advances the last-written frame.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_PrefetchNextTimedRecord
applied.evidence: Within a five-millisecond budget, scans record headers until the playback clock is reached, then loads the selected payload.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_DispatchRecordsUntilFrame
applied.evidence: Dispatches loaded file records through the callback until the target frame, EOF, or the five-millisecond work budget.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_DestroyRuntimeState
applied.evidence: Destroys the network decoder and reader-side owned runtime buffers/jobs.

applied.name: KWReplayWriter_DestroyRuntimeState
applied.evidence: Frees the writer's file-mode body buffer and clears its pointer.
